title: 负载端无功补偿与线路损耗
statement: V̇_s = 260∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，经电阻为 R_l = 1 Ω 的线路向感性负载 R = 16 Ω、L = 12 mH 供电。
在负载端（a 与地之间）并联电容 C，使 a 点右侧的总负载（C 与 R、L 支路并联）的功率因数恰好为 1。
求电容吸收的无功功率、线路电流 I、负载电流 I_L 和线路损耗。

questions.ask: 电容吸收的无功功率 Q_C = ?

questions.explain: I_L = V_a/|16 + j12| = 250/20 = 12.5 A——比线路电流还大：负载需要的无功电流由电容就地提供，不再流经线路。

hints: 并联补偿用导纳最方便：Y = 1/(R + jωL) = G − jB_L，电容提供 +jωC。
功率因数为 1 时 ωC = B_L，a 点右侧等效为电导 G，即电阻 1/G。
线路与等效电阻串联，先求线路电流和 V_a，再求各功率。
solution: **2. 补偿条件。** 并联电容后 Y' = 0.04 + j(ωC − 0.03)，功率因数为 1 要求 ωC = 0.03 S → C = 30 µF；此时 a 点右侧等效为 1/0.04 = 25 Ω。
**5. 对比不补偿。** I = 260/|17 + j12| = 260/20.81 ≈ 12.49 A，线路损耗 ≈ 156 W。补偿后负载得到的功率几乎不变（2500 W 对 2498 W），线路损耗却减少了约 36%。

en.title: Load-end compensation and line loss
statement: V̇_s = 260∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, feeds an inductive load R = 16 Ω, L = 12 mH through a line of resistance R_l = 1 Ω.
A capacitor C is connected at the load end (between a and ground) so that the total load to the right of a (C in parallel with the R–L branch) has a power factor of exactly 1.
Find the reactive power absorbed by the capacitor, the line current I, the load current I_L and the line loss.

questions.ask: Reactive power absorbed by the capacitor, Q_C = ?
questions.explain: Load admittance Y = 1/(16 + j12) = 0.04 − j0.03 S, so ωC = 0.03 S is needed (C = 30 µF). The parallel combination is Y = 0.04 S, i.e. a pure 25 Ω. V_a = 260 × 25/26 = 250 V, Q_C = −ωC·V_a² = −0.03 × 62500 = −1875 var.
Total impedance = 1 + 25 = 26 Ω (purely resistive), I = 260/26 = 10 A.
I_L = V_a/|16 + j12| = 250/20 = 12.5 A — larger than the line current: the reactive current the load needs is supplied locally by the capacitor and no longer flows through the line.
P_l = I²R_l = 100 × 1 = 100 W. Without compensation I = 260/|17 + j12| ≈ 12.49 A and the line loss is about 156 W.

hints: Parallel compensation is easiest with admittances: Y = 1/(R + jωL) = G − jB_L, and the capacitor adds +jωC.
Unity power factor means ωC = B_L; the load to the right of a is then the conductance G, i.e. a resistance 1/G.
The line is in series with that equivalent resistance: find the line current and V_a first, then the powers.
solution: **2. Compensation condition.** With the capacitor Y' = 0.04 + j(ωC − 0.03); unity power factor requires ωC = 0.03 S → C = 30 µF, and the load to the right of a is then 1/0.04 = 25 Ω.

**3. Currents and voltage.** I = 260/(1 + 25) = **10 A**, V_a = 25 × 10 = 250 V, I_L = 250/20 = **12.5 A**, I_C = 0.03 × 250 = 7.5 A. Check: the reactive component of I_L, 12.5 × 0.6 = 7.5 A, is cancelled by I_C, and its active component 12.5 × 0.8 = 10 A = I ✓.
**4. Powers.** Q_C = −ωC·V_a² = **−1875 var** (= −Q_load = −I_L² × 12 = −1875 ✓); load P = I_L² × 16 = 2500 W; line loss P_l = I²R_l = **100 W**.

**5. Without compensation.** I = 260/|17 + j12| = 260/20.81 ≈ 12.49 A and the line loss ≈ 156 W. With compensation the load receives practically the same power (2500 W vs 2498 W) while the line loss drops by about 36%.
